cases.title: COPY, ROTATE Copy and SCALE Copy of pit P3 each make a real CE pit: a CE line says it was numbered as new and the copy comes with its own PIT LABEL
cases.plan_item: BUG-665 reproduction only: COPY control and missing labels after ROTATE Copy and SCALE Copy with the switch OFF; D15 not proved
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-665 in BUG_CARPARK.md (Grip-Ctrl copy, ROTATE Copy and SCALE Copy of a pit or pipe: expected "the copy gets the same clean-up a COPY gets: new pit number, own labels, own record") and daily card D15 (COPY: "1 pit copied and numbered as new", new pit number, one U). The Grip-Ctrl copy of BUG-665 is not driven. BUG-210, BUG-288, BUG-666 and BUG-671 (other COPY faults of group M3) are not claimed.
cases.expected: The plain COPY of pit P3 (the control) prints "1 pit copied and numbered as new." and adds one pit block (layer STORMWATER PIT) and one PIT LABEL block (layer STORMWATER PIT LABEL). ROTATE Copy by 90 degrees and SCALE Copy by 1.5 of the same pit must each give the same: a CE line saying one pit was copied and numbered as new, and one new PIT LABEL block beside the new pit block, so the copy has a number of its own and is not a twin of P3.
cases.why_not_unit: The copy clean-up runs when AutoCAD ends the native COPY, ROTATE or SCALE command on the live drawing.
not_automated: The new pit's NUMBER is not read (the PIT LABEL attribute is not exposed by the object read, and the Pit Schedule cells are not asserted): the case reads the CE line and the presence of the label block. The Grip-Ctrl copy of BUG-665 is not driven.
If the rotated or scaled copy gets its label a few seconds after the command, the 8 second wait here would show it; a later label would not be seen.
